scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of robed pilgrims carrying baskets along a stone path toward a hillside city gate. Pale houses and a rectangular sanctuary rise beneath blue-gray clouds and amber light. Olive branches frame the view; bread, figs and a clay jug rest on a foreground ledge.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Pilgrims and feast provisions imagine the recurring festivals of Ariel, understood here as Jerusalem, David's city. Gathering clouds and shadow give visual weight to the cry of woe; the verse does not describe this weather or these travelers. Architecture and clothing are imaginative conventions, not archaeological certainties. David is absent because the verse recalls his earlier dwelling.
